title: What this project did, step by step
intro: Every scanned page of Fr. Solanus Casey's letters and prayer notebooks flows through seven steps, from raw scans to a searchable, citable knowledge tool. Each step is its own folder of reproducible scripts (pipeline_v3/step_N).

steps.title: Clean the scans
steps.summary: Prepare and clean the raw scanned PDFs of the letters and notebooks (pdf_cleaner) so later steps work from consistent page images.

steps.title: Crop pages into regions
steps.summary: Cut each page into its parts — recipient, greeting, body, signature, dates, etc. — as bounding-box regions, with a manual editor to fix the boxes.

steps.title: Normalize & review
steps.summary: Normalize the cropped regions to a common shape and review labeled examples before training the auto-labeler.

steps.title: Auto-label every region
steps.summary: Machine-label each region's category across the whole corpus, then apply hand corrections/relabels. David holds final labeling authority (gold is David-only).
steps.next: Spot-check any volumes flagged as drifted before re-running downstream steps.

steps.title: OCR & clean the text
steps.summary: Read the text from each region with Azure OCR (both passes kept), then clean common OCR patterns and enrich each page. Nothing is thrown away.
steps.next: Continue curating the cleaning rules as new error patterns surface.

steps.title: Segment into documents
steps.summary: Split the corpus into individual documents: correspondence as per-letter records (grouped via the tables of contents), notebooks as page-and-entry records. An audit guarantees every region is kept.
steps.next: Use the TOCs further as a name authority (see step 7 to-dos).

steps.title: Build the archive tool (this app)
steps.summary: Turn the documents into a research tool: extract named entities (people, places, conditions, favors, dates), then run a context-aware ENTITY ENGINE that reads each one in its source context, researches what it actually is, disambiguates it (e.g. 'Colorado' in a Detroit address is a street, not the state), and cautiously merges duplicates into canonical entities. Build a temporal knowledge graph, map the places, embed everything for hybrid search, and answer questions with a tool-using agent that cites the exact scanned region (and the Crosby biography).
steps.next: Entity engine has run (35.9k -> 31.7k canonical, noise dropped, places disambiguated). Graph + map + timeline are live with the viz upgrades (clusters layout, clickable legend, date-brush, confidence slider, Street View). Next: audit-driven merge/classification refinements, optional convergence passes, TOC/Wikidata name authority, and pushing the retrieval eval to target.

todo.title: Audit-driven refinements
todo.detail: Apply the entity-engine audit findings (recover any wrongly-dropped real entities, tighten merge normalization for honorific variants, fix any bad geocodes).

todo.title: TOC / Wikidata name authority
todo.detail: Use the tables of contents (curated recipient names) + Wikidata/VIAF as ground-truth spellings to confirm canonical names and link notable people/places.

todo.title: Convergence / deeper passes
todo.detail: The engine is loop-capable (--passes, --max-cost): re-think merged entities for richer identities if desired.

todo.title: Eval to target
todo.detail: Push retrieval precision/recall to the thresholds with more golden questions + tuning.
